items.title: Microsoft (MSFT) Faces Consumer Probes Over Microsoft 365 And Copilot Changes
items.summary: UK, Australian, and Italian regulators have opened investigations into Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) regarding Microsoft 365 subscription changes and the integration of Copilot features.
